objective: Independent QA and security review of Egg Garden v0.3 (GARDEN-023 to GARDEN-025) against decision 0014 and GDD section U, producing the review and the evidence for the v0.3 checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: docs/qa/garden-v03-review.md exists in the garden-v02-review.md format: scope, tool runs, severity table, verdict, findings labelled Computed, Read or Director
Odds, prices, levels, grow times, meters and INDEX_SIZE in GardenConfig equal decision 0014 (Computed, by script); every egg's buy-hatch-release return is under 60% by the spec's bound
A pre-0014 save loads unchanged and a save holding a new species survives sanitize; no new remote, Fx kind or attribute exists; adminGrant still refuses non-admins for the new ids
Cries obey the sfx setting, never play on a refusal, and every id used has a register row from a licensed partner; no mutation changes TextureID, Color or Material (Read)
The checkpoint doc lists the evidence: CI run link, test counts, build stamp, screenshot of the three Lions, a recording of the cries
verification: A04 reads the review; CI run link and test-results.json attached as evidence
notes: Reviewer must not have written GARDEN-023, 024 or 025 (CLAUDE.md rule 2). Studio facts count only with the build stamp (rule 13).
